evidence_basis: Reread for the Ih, Rin, RMP, sag and ZD7288 numbers: full text as text including Methods and Table 1. Images viewed: Fig 1 (Rin and RMP bars) and Fig 3 (Ih density, normalised activation). Figs 2 and 5 were extracted from a truncated archive but not viewed; Figs 4 and 6 were not recoverable (Fig 6 carries the ZD7288 Rin and RMP panels, read here from the text only). An earlier complete receipt exists.
